title: Enterprise custom dashboard request playbook — data contracts, cost estimator, and gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers are submitting ad-hoc custom dashboard requests via support and CSMs that require non-trivial data joins, span multiple tenants, or need sample-based exports. Current handling is ad hoc, causing long lead times, unclear cost estimates, and occasional privacy gating misses.

Goal: Ship a triage playbook and self-serve template that productizes the evaluation path for enterprise dashboard asks so we can: 1) estimate engineering effort and infra cost up-front, 2) gate sensitive data and PII early, and 3) provide deterministic SLAs for delivery lanes (Self-serve template, Configurable request, Eng+PM scoped deliverable).

Deliverables:
- A standardized intake form (CSM + Support) capturing data contract, retention, cardinality, join keys, sampling needs, and customer acceptance criteria.
- A cost-estimator prototype (spreadsheet + simple formula) that converts cardinality / retention / export cadence into a one-time infra estimate + ongoing hourly token/compute estimate.
- A triage rubric that maps requests into lanes: Self-serve, Configurable (product work), or Eng+PM scoped (custom). Each lane has target SLAs and an approval checklist.
- Privacy & legal gating checklist integrated into intake (flags for PII, cross-tenant joins, EU-data residency).
- Internal playbook doc (Confluence) and a short onboarding deck for CSMs and Solutions Engineers.

Success metrics:
- Median time-to-first-response for enterprise dashboard requests reduced from 7 business days to 2 business days.
- 50% of requests routed into self-serve or configurable lanes within 2 months.
- Reduction in infra surprise incidents from custom exports by 80% over first quarter post rollout.

Constraints / trade-offs:
- Building a fully accurate cost estimator requires runtime telemetry we don't currently expose to PMs; initial estimator will be conservative and spreadsheet-based.
- Some enterprise requests will still require data engineering work that can't be productized; playbook must avoid false promises.

Notes: This ticket focuses on process + lightweight tooling (templates, estimator, doc) — not on dashboard product feature implementation. Any feature work surfaced by the playbook should spawn separate ENG tickets.
